text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I got so absorbed in my work that it was
already the middle of the night.
In just a few hours, the date would change.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Wait.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Where are you going?
Get back to the academy.
choice_data_list: Orfe!? What are you doing here at this hour—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Night owl peace-peaaace...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
Both of you, greetings come first!
Show some respect to your superiors!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You're not doing it either.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ha!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me, sir!
I am Fenomeno, sir!
Affiliation: Miho! Rank: Pre-debut!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ponkan's an unplaced Gold Ship runner~!
Hassaku's at Ritto,
and Lime is also yet to debut!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmm!
Stop half-heartedly copying me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno and Gold Ship...
I see the two of them hanging out with Orfevre a lot.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Good evening, Trainer.
What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If it isn't at this exact time,
it has no meaning at all.
After all, today is—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—a GⅠ race held at
ParisLongchamp Racecourse in France.
However, it is no ordinary GⅠ—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Back then, Speed Symboli, the strongest Umamusume in the nation,
made the first attempt and was defeated. Since that day,
countless famous Umamusume have challenged it, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The "ultimate dream" that no one has reached yet...
A race that could be called Japan's long-cherished wish.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Return in haste,
and prepare the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Bring that distant land
before My very eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... I ended up watching the Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe on the big monitor in the
Trainer's room together with Orfevre and the others.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The Golshi-chan Set, bam!
A takoyaki maker and ashitaba. And then...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
It was a relief to meet someone so dependable.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: We could have watched from the dorms, but... it's bound to be quite lively there.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Even so, there's a curfew... Just as I was fretting over what to do, Orfe—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Use your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, with that said,
I submitted an outing request for the time being
and came all the way here."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I wrote down 'Researching overseas races with Trainer'...
I apologize for doing so without your permission.
choice_data_list: Well, I understand the situation, so...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—The voices are pitching high.
It's about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Two Uma Musume from Japan entered this year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
One of whom was...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh! There she goes,
—Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Nakayama Festa—despite being an 8th-favorite underdog in this year's Takarazuka Kinen, she delivered a shocking blow with a ferocious final spurt to seize her first GⅠ victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at that race where she defeated the ever-popular
Buena Vista, you'd think more attention would be drawn to
her strength on the grand stage, but...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmh.
It has already changed.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: It seems the level of local interest isn't very high...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Same goes for Japan, doesn't it?
There are no public viewings, and the newspapers aren't making a fuss either.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It just means fewer folks dream of makin' it big in a band these days. Tough times, man...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...In other words, rather than it being about Nakayama Festa, the passion for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe itself has dwindled... perhaps?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...However.
Thus, the stage has been set."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I know all too well
about that one's bad habits.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Remember... that face.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Her eyes are blazing brightly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And this year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, which just got underway—
defied most expectations with a gripping, nail-biting turn of events!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...HAAAAAHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!!
Only 300 meters left to the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Nakayama Festa bursts through the pack on the final straight!
She enters a fierce clash with another Umamusume
who surged out from the inside...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Go for it--!!
Just blast right past 'em all the way to the end~~!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: —...So the result was 2nd place, was it?
choice_data_list: And by a head, no less...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's the closest any Japanese Umamusume has ever come to victory.
In the studio after the broadcast, the guests are discussing it with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
“Thanks to Nakayama Festa's valiant effort,
Japan was able to dream once more!
That is a truly valuable 2nd place...!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh...!
That's incredible, yes it is!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A valuable 2nd place.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I chased after Orfevre after she quietly slipped
out of the Trainer's Room, only to find her
gazing up at the sky.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama must be
quite dissatisfied as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
To be praised this much,
even in 2nd place...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
That distant land...
has become far too distant.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I shall
open the eyes of my people.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Is the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe just a distant dream? —No, it is not."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking as she walked, Orfevre made her way
through the nighttime academy. Each of her words
seemed to synchronize with every single step..."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is just one single crown."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It is merely one of many things
that should be offered to me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A longing past its time,
a fully ripened dream...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Everything...
I will smash it all to pieces.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
And that frenzy
shall turn into praise for the triumphant king.
choice_data_list: You truly believe... you're the one to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?
Are you saying that *you* will win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Naturally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "You can really say that with so much confidence, huh—" I hastily swallowed the words. But Orfevre seemed to see right through me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Can you really say that with such certainty—?" I hastily swallowed the words. But Orfevre seemed to see right through me...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Allow me to teach you,
you vulgar commoner."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The King willed it.
Thus—all creation comes to pass.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Know reason.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without a single shred of doubt, she believed in herself completely.
Seeing her like that, I understood in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
My younger sister, Orfevre...
is a born ruler.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...No, let me rephrase that.
They are a chosen existence, endowed with the caliber of a king.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is the "chosen" Umamusume.
The one to fulfill Japan's long-cherished dream—is her, the champion.
Without a shred of hesitation, she shoulders everyone's dreams—
choice_data_list: (The one who will fulfill that long-cherished wish is—her)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...It's chilly.
choice_data_list: (It's her trust, so I want to earn it.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not merely to ensure things go smoothly, but so that she can entrust her entire heart to me.
—So that I can become her foremost, most loyal subject.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Let's go back.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
It feels quite unreliable.
HoweverâI shall make use of it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
It seems you aren't just honest and obedient.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...I entrust it to you.
Please protect it—even if it costs you your life.
